_meta.description: Which loyalty program can issue award tickets on which operating airline, including cross-alliance and bilateral partnerships. Use to determine if a user can actually redeem on a specific airline, and the cheapest booking path.
_meta.notes: Always verify partner availability on the booking program's own site before committing a transfer.

aeroplan.notes: Widest Star Alliance availability. Can book Lufthansa First. Per-passenger cancel fees.

virgin_atlantic_flying_club.notes: THE legendary cross-alliance sweet spot: ANA business/first at dramatically lower rates than any Star Alliance program. ANA must be booked by phone.

avianca_lifemiles.notes: Often prices Star Alliance awards cheaper than United/Aeroplan. No fuel surcharges on most awards.

turkish_miles_and_smiles.notes: United domestic sweet spots. Turkey direct 65K J. Can be bureaucratic to book.

american_aadvantage.notes: Cathay and JAL business/first are the targets. Web specials can be excellent.

british_airways_avios.notes: Avios shared across BA, Iberia, Qatar, Finnair. Great for short-haul. WARNING: high fuel surcharges on BA-metal long-haul. Book partner airlines to avoid.

iberia_avios.notes: 40,500 Avios off-peak US East Coast to Madrid business class is a standout sweet spot.

qatar_privilege_club.notes: Qsuites business class saver is the target. Low surcharges on Qatar metal.

flying_blue.notes: Monthly promo awards. Free stopovers on one-way awards (by phone).

tap_miles_and_go.notes: Lisbon-hubbed fixed award chart. Useful intra-Europe and to Portugal.

cross_alliance_highlights.name: Virgin Atlantic to ANA
cross_alliance_highlights.why: The single most valuable cross-alliance partnership. ANA first/business from the US West Coast at far lower rates than any Star Alliance program.

cross_alliance_highlights.name: Etihad to American Airlines
cross_alliance_highlights.why: Etihad's fixed chart for AA metal is often cheaper than AA's own dynamic pricing.
